integrity: Proof and exact standalone verification script supplied. Finite tests are corroboration, not a proof.
scientific_limitations: The polynomial lcm and its specialization at q=1 are proved for n>=1 and r>=2 with zero parts permitted. The claim does not extend specialization commutation to arbitrary numeric q>=2. Priority comparisons cannot rule out unindexed literature; this is not an independent audit.
title: Multinomial least-common-multiple law and exact specialization at one
